title: 第5章 大风暴第7章 兄妹联手
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
“这是真的！我来这里两个月了，竟然听到魔阳门弟子和傲剑宗弟子说话！不仅如此，据我们掌教所说，傲剑宗内部多年来一直存在内讧。一方与魔阳一族勾结，魔阳一族应该以傲剑宗北督为首。不过，没有任何证据，我院长也无法采取行动。”
冷幽兰回答道。
沉翔观察着光明洞里的一些石头，说道：“幽兰，你一个人在这里待了两个月，一定很不容易吧！”
“这和我修炼时遇到的情况相比，根本算不了什么，现在更糟糕了。”
冷幽兰一副与她无关的样子，笑道：“兄弟，我现在肯定比你更厉害了！我可是真武境四重，而且还有冰火神脉！但院长为了保护我，对外宣称我只有冰火天脉。”
沉翔被这个爆料惊呆了，就连苏媚瑶和白幽幽都惊呼连连。冷幽兰竟然拥有冰火神脉！难怪她进步这么快！
沉翔取出一块地核神果果肉，递给了冷幽兰，冷幽兰则毫不客气地吃了下去。
“幽兰，任何事情都不能说是绝对的。虽然我只是真武境二重，但如果和你打……嘿嘿。”
沉翔笑着说道。
吃完地心神果后，冷幽兰皱了皱眉，甜甜一笑：“兄弟，这是好东西！”
她闭上眼睛，稍微喘了口气，才重新睁开眼睛。
沉翔一愣，哪怕是丹长老或者古东辰那些涅盘境强者，炼化地核神果果浆也花了好几天的时间。但冷幽兰几乎是一瞬间就炼化完毕！
“幽兰，你没有炼化它吗？”
沉翔问道。
“我正在炼化它！只是我的火冰真气很特殊，它可以自我炼化，然后将那股力量融入到我的体内！”
冷幽兰再次给沉翔倒了一杯那香醇的酒。
“哥，你说你比我强，那打架怎么样？”
冷幽兰握紧玉拳，一脸兴奋的问道。沉翔没想到自己的结拜妹妹竟然这么好战。
“不用这么着急，我先把这里的事情处理一下，处理完之后，我就带你去太武宗玩！”
沉翔笑着说道。有这么厉害的妹妹在这里，沉翔顿时感觉轻松了许多。

“嗯，就算院长来阻止我，我也会跟着你去太武宗！”
冷幽兰兴奋的说道。
“你们的院长是女的吗？”
沉翔问道。
“是啊，不过我从来没见过她的脸，她和你们太武宗的丹长老一样，一直戴着面具。我去太武宗的时候，也是丹长老向院长推荐我的。”随后，她就直接带我去了冰风谷，她对我很好，看来她和神兵天国女帝的关系也不错，上次送楼的正是女帝。基础丹，兄弟，没想到你的未婚夫竟然是薛仙仙。”
说最后一句话的时候，冷幽兰的声音里带着一丝嫉妒。
当沉翔想起丹长老、神兵天帝女帝、柳梦儿、冰风谷掌教、丹香桃源掌教这四位女巨头时，沉翔强颜欢笑。这四人之中，三人都是来自三个不同地域的强大势力的巨头，而丹长老也算是太武宗的巨头之一。更何况，这四个人都是女性！除了神兵天帝国的柳梦儿之外，其他三人都十分神秘。更重要的是，他们之间似乎都有着密切的关系。
“太武宗开采的矿脉，目前已经被魔阳宗弟子围攻，不过你们太武宗的人，可不是那么好对付的，目前，矿脉还没有被攻破，魔阳宗的弟子们，可不是那么好对付的。”
content_en:
"It's true! I've been here for two months, and I actually heard the disciples of the Mo Yang Clan and the disciples of the Proud Sword Sect talking! Not only that, according to our headmaster, there has been internal strife within the Proud Sword Sect for many years. One party has colluded with the Mo Yang Clan, and the Mo Yang Clan should be led by the North Governor of the Proud Sword Sect. However, without any evidence, my dean cannot take action."
Leng Youlan replied.
Chen Xiang observed some stones in Guangming Cave and said, "Youlan, it must be very difficult for you to stay here alone for two months!"
"This is nothing compared to the situation I encountered when I was practicing. It's even worse now."
Leng Youlan looked like she had nothing to do with her and said with a smile: "Brother, I am definitely more powerful than you now! I am at the fourth level of the True Martial Realm, and I also have the Ice and Fire Divine Veins! But in order to protect me, the dean declared that I only have the Ice and Fire Heavenly Veins."
Chen Xiang was shocked by this revelation, and even Su Meiyao and Bai Youyou exclaimed in surprise. Leng Youlan actually possesses the Ice and Fire Divine Veins! No wonder she's progressing so quickly!
Chen Xiang took out a piece of earth core divine fruit pulp and handed it to Leng Youlan, who ate it without ceremony.
"Youlan, nothing can be said to be absolute. Although I am only at the second level of the True Martial Realm, if I fight you...hehe."
Chen Xiang said with a smile.
After eating the Earth Core Fruit, Leng Youlan frowned and smiled sweetly: "Brother, this is good stuff!"
She closed her eyes, took a breath, and then opened them again.
Chen Xiang was stunned. Even Elder Dan or Gu Dongchen, who were powerful in the Nirvana realm, had spent several days refining the earth core divine fruit pulp. But Leng Youlan finished refining it almost instantly!
"Youlan, didn't you refine it?"
Chen Xiang asked.
"I'm refining it! It's just that my fire and ice energy is very special. It can refine itself and then integrate that power into my body!"
Leng Youlan poured Chen Xiang another glass of fragrant wine.
"Brother, you said you are stronger than me, how about a fight?"
Leng Youlan clenched her jade fist and asked excitedly. Chen Xiang didn't expect that his sworn sister would be so bellicose.
"Don't be so anxious. I'll take care of things here first. After that, I'll take you to Taiwuzong to play!"
Chen Xiang said with a smile. With such a powerful sister here, Chen Xiang suddenly felt much more relaxed.
"Well, even if the dean comes to stop me, I will follow you to Taiwuzong!"
Leng Youlan said excitedly.
"Is your dean a woman?"
Chen Xiang asked.
"Yes, but I have never seen her face. She always wears a mask like Elder Dan of your Taiwu Sect. When I went to Taiwuzong, Elder Dan recommended me to the dean." Then, she took me directly to Icewind Valley. She was very good to me. It seemed that she had a good relationship with the Empress of the Divine Weapon Heavenly Kingdom. It was the Empress who sent me to the building last time. Basic Pill, brother, I didn’t expect your fiancé to be Xue Xianxian. "
When she said the last sentence, there was a hint of jealousy in Leng Youlan's voice.
When Chen Xiang thought of the four female giants, Elder Dan, the Divine Weapon Emperor and Empress, Liu Meng'er, the Headmaster of Icewind Valley, and the Headmaster of Danxiang Taoyuan, Chen Xiang forced a smile on his face. Among these four people, three are giants from powerful forces in three different regions, and Elder Dan is also considered one of the giants of Taiwuzong. What's more, these four people are all women! Except for Liu Meng'er from the Divine Weapon Heavenly Empire, the other three are very mysterious. What's more, they all seem to have a close relationship with each other.
"The mineral veins mined by Taiwuzong have been besieged by the disciples of Moyang Sect. However, the people of Taiwuzong are not so easy to deal with. At present, the mineral veins have not been breached. The disciples of Moyang Sect are not so easy to deal with. "
